svg.aria-label: Proxy resolution tries three storage slots in fallback order. For USDC the first two read empty and the legacy zeppelinos slot resolves to the real implementation.
svg.title: Following the proxy to the real code
svg.desc: Three slot checks in order: the EIP-1967 implementation slot, the EIP-1967 beacon slot, then the legacy zeppelinos slot. For USDC on Base the first two are empty and the third resolves, so the implementation is scanned instead of the proxy shell.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three slots, tried in order. USDC only answers on the third.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A scanner that only knows the EIP-1967 slot finds nothing here and analyses the proxy shell instead of the token.
